'''Bacara''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], Bacara and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kosh (Jedi)|Kosh]] were stationed at the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on [[Voss]]. Upon finding ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] technology in the old ruins, they were ambushed by [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] and Bacara ordered Kosh to flee before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a single shot in the head. Wounded, Kosh made it back to the outpost and asked a Republic citizen to complete the task the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] started.<ref name="Forbidden" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bacara was first mentioned ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. He was originally slated to appear in game but the content was cut. His in game appearance is shown to be [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] in a datamined file on https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/master-bacara.<ref name="Forbidden" />
